segments.text: [70:11]  When they see them, the guilty will wish he could give his own children as ransom, to spare him the retribution of that day.
segments.speaker: Edip

segments.text: [70:12]  Also his spouse, and his brother.
segments.speaker: Edip

segments.text: [70:13]  Even his whole tribe that raised him.
segments.speaker: Edip

segments.text: [70:14]  Even all the people on earth, if it would save him.
segments.speaker: Edip

segments.text: Here, we see the horror of that day, that people will give up from everything that he likes...
segments.speaker: Edip
